---
name: DAW profile
about: Something in a DAW profile (FL Studio, Ableton Live, Logic Pro, Pro Tools, Cubase, Studio One) doesn't feel like the real DAW, or a new profile
labels: profile
---

**Profile**: (fl / ableton / logic / protools / cubase / studioone / new)

**In the real DAW**: what it looks like or does (version, and a manual link if you have one)

**In REAPER with the profile**: what happens instead

**Kind**: look / shortcut / mouse / toolbar / layout / preference / missing feature

Screenshots of the real DAW are welcome as reference in the issue, but they can't be added to the repo.
